LiberationAwardNormals.AddArtefact: We thought long and hard about your reward and decided that it must be something special. So, please accept this <Artefact>!
LiberationAwardNormals.AddNod: On behalf of the Coordination Council of the Ranger Center Network, allow me to present you with this special present: <Nod>!
LiberationAwardNormals.AddProgramms: As a token of our gratitude, we would like to upgrade your onboard computer with the <Programm> program. Number of copies: <Count>.
LiberationAwardNormals.AddReward: On behalf of the entire <Star> system we wish to award you with an order reflecting your valor: <Reward>! We hope it will inspire you to even greater heights.

LiberationAwardPirateClan.AddArtefact: We thought long and hard about your reward and decided that it must be something special. So, please accept this <Artefact>!
LiberationAwardPirateClan.AddNod: And as a sign of our special relationship, allow me to present you with this special present: <Nod>!
LiberationAwardPirateClan.AddProgramms: As a token of our gratitude, we would like to upgrade your onboard computer with the <Programm> program. Number of copies: <Count>.
LiberationAwardPirateClan.AddReward: On behalf of the entire <Star> system we wish to award you with an order reflecting your valor: <Reward>! We hope it will inspire you to even greater heights.

LiberationStarNormalsFromKling.FeiText: A brilliant fight following by a brilliant victory, ensuring that the name <Player> shall be immortalized in the annals of the <Star> system. We expect that you will keep up the good fight with the same fervor. Allow us to express our gratitude for liberating our system from the dominator invasion.
LiberationStarNormalsFromKling.GaalText: <Player>, we didn't doubt for a second that a courageous leader such as yourself would liberate our wonderful <Star> system. Please allow us to thank you for your brilliant victory.
LiberationStarNormalsFromKling.MalocText: <Player>, we are happy to welcome a great warrior such as yourself on the hospitable maloq planet <Planet>! Allow us to express our gratitude for liberating our system from the dominator invasion.
LiberationStarNormalsFromKling.PelengText: <Player>, you have set a wonderful example of courage and heroism for our youth! We endeavor to follow your example. Allow us to express our gratitude for liberating our system from the dominator invasion.
LiberationStarNormalsFromKling.PeopleText: All hail <Player>, a great warrior who routed throngs of dominators and liberated the <Star> system! We want to express our sincerest gratitude and appreciation.

LiberationStarNormalsFromPirateClan.FeiText: You are a true hero, <Player>! In our hour of need you came to the aid of a star system plagued by pirates and achieved success where the Coalition's military suffered an inglorious defeat! Your name has been entered into history books on all the planets in our sector. Allow us to thank you properly for the millions of Coalition subjects you've saved!
LiberationStarNormalsFromPirateClan.GaalText: Certainly, living under the boot of pirate aggressors, hopelessly lacking any aspiration to attain insight and harmony of the universe, was tough for us, like an unsolvable combination in Iike-Baana. Blessed are we that there are still heroes like you in this Galaxy, <Player>. Allow us to thank you for liberating our star system and returning it into Coalition hands.
LiberationStarNormalsFromPirateClan.MalocText: We salute your valor, <Player>! Like a ferocious swarokok, you swooped into our star system and tore those pathetic pirates to shreds! Of course, we would have dealt with them ourselves sooner or later, but thanks just the same for saving us time and resources. And now we want to honor you properly, the great warrior that you are!
LiberationStarNormalsFromPirateClan.PelengText: You know, <Player>, for a creature with limited limbs you sure did a great job mopping up those pirate occupiers in our system. Sure, they were good company and hella fun, but seeing as we have a long-standing contract with the Coalition, we feel it's best to maintain this course. For as long as the Coalition still exists, that is. In the meantime, let us thank you for your efforts.
LiberationStarNormalsFromPirateClan.PeopleText: Your help in driving out the pirate invaders from our star system was invaluable, <Player>! Watching your triumphant battle from planetside was great fun! I bet the video will get a gazillion hits on GalaTube in no time. And while it's being uploaded, allow us to thank you for rescuing us!

0.Text: Those domers ain't so tough after all, eh, <Player>?! With your help, we sure gave 'em hell! We pirates are the toughest SOBs in the Galaxy! Neither the Coalition nor the dominators can touch us!

1.Text: Many of our bros are surprised that we're capturing systems from dominators and not from the Coalition. They ain't smart enough to know the meaning of strategy and tactics -- all they care about is raiding and shooting their guns. But you and I, <Player>, we understand the importance of it. So from one wise guy to another, thanks for helping to capture this system!

2.Text: Ha, those stupid tin cans didn't know what hit 'em! And you crushed them bastards like insects, <Player>! It's great to see you put your ranger's past to good use. If nothing else, you lot are masters at beating up on dominators. Now this star system is ours, and I want to thank you on behalf of the entire pirate community for a glorious fight!

3.Text: That's how we roll, eh, <Player>?! Those Coalition wussies may be powerless against the tin cans they themselves have created, but we sure as hell ain't! You definitely proved that with this fight today. The system is now ours, and we're gonna be divvying up the booty soon. This calls for a celebration!

0.Text: Excellent work, <Player>! Yet another system is in our hands, and your contribution is very much recognized and appreciated. Keep up the good work, and soon people will forget the meaning of the word "Coalition"!

Text: Har-har, <Player>, my friend, up top! Excellent work up there on the orbit. Seeing you in action was a treat -- you're a real animal!

Now that the system is ours, you can relax and let loose. But not too loose, you hear? We've got big plans for this here planet. Oh, by the way, the bar is right around the corner, if you're interested. Everybody's already there and waiting on you!

2.Text: <Player>, thank you for helping us in that fight on the orbit. If it weren't for you, things might have ended badly for us. Fortunately, the battle is over, and now we can look forward to celebrating and splitting loot. Let's hope the Coalition forces won't be visiting us for a while; and if they do, we'll give 'em a proper pirate welcome. Are you in? Hell, of course you are!

3.Text: Excellent, <Player>, simply excellent. Your help in establishing control over this system was invaluable. And it's always great to take those goody two-shoes Coalition punks down a peg. They fought like they had never even smelled a whiff of gunpowder... And now they never will! Anyway, we won, and winners are right by default. And you know what else winners are? They are congratulated, so let me shake your firm hand -- or better yet, both of them! The more the merrier, I say!

Text: Oh, hic... <Player>, sorry, I'm just so, hic... hammered! While yer out dere congraidulatin' folk, cherin' in deir joys... You were gr8! Or waz it you... Daaamn, twins! C'mere, lemme kiss you both on da lips! Wait, where you goin'... Dis is a cellebrashin, and you twos are lik' twos peas in a pod, ha-ha-ha! Dat was a gewd joke...
Ugh, my head! I apologize for my behavior, <Player>. It is a noble pirate ritual to drink a shot for every survivor. And so I raise this full glass for you with pride!

Quest.AddArtefact: In this case, money cannot be considered fair payment for what you've done, <Player>. Therefore, as an added bonus we would like to present you with this special gift: <Artefact>!
Quest.AddNod: But that's not all. We must admit that the successful completion of this task is worthy of any ranger. As an added bonus, the Ranger Center Network Coordination Council would like to give you this special gift: micromodule <Nod>!
Quest.AddNodPirate: But that's not all. We must admit that the successful completion of this task is worthy of any ranger. As an added bonus, I would like to give you this special gift: micromodule <Nod>!

Quest.AddReward: We would also like to honor you with <Reward> for your successful operation. Glory is more important than money, is it not?
